findings: The one LilScript compiler (24968659) rebuilt the port from the unified/trough/VFile rewrite; dist/unified.esm.js, dist/unified.closed.js and dist/vfile.esm.js are compiler output plus the license banner, with no post-minifier.
dist/unified.cjs, dist/unified.umd.js and dist/vfile.cjs are esbuild format conversions of the compiler's ESM (not minified): post-processed by esbuild, not compiler-written (plan M12.2).
Previous public dist/unified.esm.js 4206 -> 4199 Brotli-11 (the previous file was compiled by aa2052f0, the 2026-09-24 release).
Against the source-built official graph: Terser 4339, Oxc 4411, esbuild 4612 Brotli-11; ours 4199.
This compiler renames no properties, so the closed lane (lilscript.closed.toml) differs from the npm compile only through its optimizer settings: 4197 vs 4199 Brotli-11.
Upstream version gap: pinned 11.0.5; no compatibility upgrade is implied.
